sentence: The production model of §§27–28 (one self-dividing maker; Theophrastus the first draft of the Aristotle position; Aristotle the legal identity) is the model the texts are consistent with and the one whose architecture III.5 states: one mind, a making part and a becoming part, related as a craft to its material; no evidence in the corpus requires a second maker, and the evidence offered for one is of a different kind from the texts it is offered against. v0.1 read III.5 as the Sappho line's technology "proposed, not demonstrated" at a third substrate. v0.2 locates the technology in III.5's own text (§12) and finds it operating on the corpus that transmits III.5.
